title: Runner-hosted AI worker, PR task-board sync and P00 closeout checks
summary: AI worker runs on GitHub-hosted runners (rootless Docker, local Ollama 7b, hostile-candidate containment, bounded model timeout, contract in first prompt); scoped bot-branch writer; same-repo PR task-board sync limited to the phase primary PR; task-board check accepts the closeout PR once the phase is MERGED_VERIFIED; CI host/queue smokes use an active-P00 fixture root.
migration_notes: No product release. P00 tools stay restricted to an active P00 state; CI smokes use tests/fixtures/p00_active_root instead of live PHASE.json.
